sentences.text: Kustservice i Finland Ab Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-25 under the industry code 50200, sea and coastal freight water transport.
First sales are recorded on 2026-10-01, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-10-06.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file, and the register confidence for the entry is low.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry fits the thesis, but nothing else on record shows technology or growth.
